scope: Reviewed inventory delta: the complete contribution groups (code COMDAT, associative .debug$F, section definitions and symbols inside) of the declared unaccepted definitions change to the pinned contents; no function is added or removed; every other section, symbol, auxiliary record and relocation stays identical; every accepted contribution of the unit (all modules built from this object) stays byte-, flag- and ordered-relocation identical. No acceptance of pending functions.

rationale._eng1_02920: Lane t5 source form (only this body changes): the complete fresh contribution becomes relocation-masked equal to ENG1 0x2920 (240 bytes, next entry 0x2a10) and is staged as the new masked row eng1.02920. eng1_02d80 and eng1_02500 are unchanged.

method: Canonical and candidate unit compiled once each with the pinned VC5 toolchain; the declaration lists every defined function whose contribution group digest differs (FILE records compared path-normalized); checked with check_delta of reviewed-unit-delta-v3 with every accepted peer protected, and refused when a change is undeclared, a pin is wrong, one masked or accepted byte is mutated, or v2 is used.
